summary: Wooded east bank of a narrow through road with no room to pull off.
reasons: No verge or pull-out beside lane
Cars park only on the west side

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto dense bush, nearest dwelling about 33 m away, but houses sit 6 to 12 m off the kerb along the rest.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with a centre line; east edge is a treed bank straight to the lane, so a van would block traffic.
drivers.traffic: Through road with steady passing traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on the east kerb; the few parked cars are on the west side near 330-350 m.

flags: Steep: about 7.6% grade at best section, 5.3% mean, steeper in places
Houses 6-12 m from the kerb at 205, 244, 274 and 285 m
Gate 36 m away has a mapped way round
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the east side; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Exact kerb width under the canopy

best_section.where: East side of Jesmond Road below the bend, backing onto bush
